name: code-of-conduct
title: Code of conduct
description: A community code of conduct people will read: the promise, expected and unacceptable behaviour in pairs, how to report, and what happens next.
docs: Give each behaviour a title and a one-line example. report.contact is the first link after the promise, so it is easy to find in a bad moment: an https link opens in a new tab and shows an arrow, a mailto or tel link stays plain. Every section and every behaviour has an anchor (#conduct-reporting); set idPrefix when a page holds two codes. scope says where the code applies, and labels translates the headings. The layout follows the width of its column, not the screen: the two lists sit side by side from 672px and the three reporting facts from 896px, so the contact never breaks across lines.
